Name: Bentleys Fast Food Useful Stuff
Author: BentleyTheModder1
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#ff9933]Bentley Playz[/color] [color=#ffcc33]Fast Food & Useful Stuff[/color][/b][/size]
[i][color=#cccccc]A walk-in restaurant, a new NPC, new food, and an arcade, all in Cindersap Forest[/color][/i]

[size=6][b][color=#ff0000]WARNING: DO NOT DRINK WINDEX![/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][b][color=#ff0000]Windex is a fictional joke item in this mod. Real glass cleaner is poisonous. Never drink it.[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]Description[/color][/b][/size]

Bentley Playz Fast Food & Useful Stuff adds [b]Bentley's Fast Food[/b], a full walk-in restaurant in Cindersap Forest, run by [b][color=#ffcc33]Bentley[/color][/b], a brand-new villager. Order at the counter, sit down at a booth, play the arcade, and visit his bedroom behind the kitchen.

Made for Nick. Content Patcher pack plus a small SMAPI code part, both in one folder.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]What it adds[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b][color=#ffcc33]Bentley's Fast Food[/color][/b]: a walk-in restaurant with its own interior and an ordering counter. No building step. It also appears on the Ice Festival versions of the Forest.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffcc33]Bentley[/color][/b]: a new NPC who owns the restaurant. He has portraits and sprites, a winter outfit, and a hazmat suit with a respirator for green rain.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffcc33]Restaurant Robot[/color][/b]: a friendly townsperson who works the counter when Bentley is away. He is like the Governor: you can chat with him, but he can't be given gifts and has no hearts.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffcc33]Seven food and drink items[/color][/b]: Cheeseburger, French Fries, Coke, Farmhand Snack Pack, Chicken Nuggets, Milkshake, and Windex (a joke item, [color=#ff0000][b]do not drink real Windex[/b][/color]).[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffcc33]Arcade room[/color][/b]: a new corner on the right side of the dining room, through the doorway in the right-hand wall. It has [b]Journey of the Prairie King[/b] and [b]Junimo Kart[/b], using the original Stardew minigames.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffcc33]Seating[/color][/b]: sit on every chair and booth in the restaurant.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffcc33]Bentley's Bedroom[/color][/b]: a private room behind the kitchen, through the staff door. The door is open to everyone.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffcc33]Open 24 hours, every day[/color][/b]: the front door and the counter shop never close.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffcc33]Welcome letter[/color][/b] from Bentley the first day you load a save with the mod.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffcc33]Update notes window[/color][/b]: every update shows its notes once after you load your save.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]How it works[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Bentley works behind the counter from the early morning until 6 PM. Then he walks to Gus's Stardrop Saloon, and he is back home in bed by 11:30 PM.[/*]
[*]While Bentley is away, the Restaurant Robot takes over the counter. The shop switches to his portrait and greeting.[/*]
[*]The restaurant is open day and night. Walk up to the door and tap it (mobile), press the action button, or click it.[/*]
[*]Counter prices: [color=#66cc66][b]Cheeseburger 180g[/b][/color], [color=#66cc66][b]French Fries 90g[/b][/color], [color=#66cc66][b]Chicken Nuggets 140g[/b][/color], [color=#66cc66][b]Coke 100g[/b][/color], [color=#66cc66][b]Milkshake 180g[/b][/color], [color=#66cc66][b]Windex 25g[/b][/color], [color=#66cc66][b]Farmhand Snack Pack 220g[/b][/color].[/*]
[*]Gus's Saloon also sells the Cheeseburger, French Fries, Coke, Windex and Farmhand Snack Pack.[/*]
[*]Bentley teaches you the Milkshake cooking recipe at [color=#ff6699][b]4 hearts[/b][/color].[/*]
[*]Drinking the in-game Windex takes 10 health by default. It never takes you below 1. You can change this in the Code folder's [b]config.json[/b] ([b]WindexDrinkDamage[/b], set it to 0 for none).[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]Requirements[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15[/b] (other 1.6.x versions untested)[/*]
[*]SMAPI [b]4.1.10[/b] or newer[/*]
[*]Content Patcher [b]2.6.0[/b] or newer[/*]
[/list]No other framework is needed.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]Installation[/color][/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Delete any older copy of this mod first, including the old [b]BentleyPlayz_FastFoodUsefulStuff[/b] and [b]BentleyPlayz_FastFoodUsefulStuff_SMAPI[/b] folders. All versions use the same mod ID, and your saves keep working.[/*]
[*]Extract the ZIP so that the folder [b]BentleyPlayz FastFoodUsefulStuff[/b] sits directly inside your [b]Mods[/b] folder. It holds both the [b]Content[/b] and [b]Code[/b] parts.[/*]
[*]Launch the game with SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][color=#ffcc33][b]Updating from older versions:[/b][/color] if you built the restaurant on your Farm with a version before 3.0.0, demolish it first. The restaurant now stands in the Forest and there is no building step.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]Latest changes[/color][/b][/size]

[color=#66ccff][b]3.11.2[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Fixed: the staff door tiles now warp you into Bentley's bedroom, so you can't stand inside the door art.[/*]
[*]Fixed: the restaurant's lights are now evenly spaced, so there are no more dark patches in the dining room.[/*]
[/list][color=#66ccff][b]3.11.1[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Fixed: the Restaurant Robot now starts each day in Bentley's bedroom and only works the counter when Bentley is away.[/*]
[/list][color=#66ccff][b]3.11.0[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]New: a larger restaurant, with a new arcade room on the right side.[/*]
[*]New: Journey of the Prairie King and Junimo Kart, plus an ARCADE sign.[/*]
[*]Every original tile, piece of furniture, seat and doorway is unchanged.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]Optional add-on: Restaurant Photo Mode[/color][/b][/size]

There's a tiny separate add-on called [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55101][b]Bentley Restaurant Photo Mode[/b][/url]. It does one thing: with a console command, it stages 12 vanilla villagers inside the restaurant for a screenshot. It's probably useless to most people, since the photo it makes is already attached to this mod, so you don't need it to play.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff9933]Known limitations[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Festival support ([b]EnableFestivals[/b] in the config) is experimental and off by default.[/*]
[/list][line]
